responsibility: Declares the COBOL front end’s source-buffer, file-span, regex-span, and pre-lexing interfaces used by lexio.cc and the scanner. It provides abstractions for mapped file regions, line/column tracking, right-margin trimming, quoted-string detection, replacement spans, and the cdftext file-processing entry points, plus utility declarations needed by the lexer to consume normalized COBOL source.
same_name_distinction: Defines the source-span abstractions, inline buffer helpers, and cdftext/filespan interfaces that lexio.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file, it is the structural and API definition layer for pre-lexed source handling.
